# Script

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/events/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A script.

A script is either a file (`path`) or inline text (`inline: true`):
exactly one of the two.
A file-backed script's digests and signatures are in `Event::file`.

Appears at: `/script`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amsi_content_sha256` | string | no |  | matches `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` | 1.0.0 | SHA-256 of the content passed to the antimalware scan interface. |

| `inline` | boolean | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | The script was inline text, not a file. Writers leave it out when it is not set. Readers also accept an explicit `false`, as 1.0 did, so this flag alone keeps two spellings until the next major version. The flags added in 1.1 accept only `true`. |
| `interpreter` | string | no |  | 1 to 256 characters | 1.0.0 | The interpreter that ran it. |
| `kind` | [`ScriptKind`](types.md#scriptkind) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | The kind of script. |
| `language_mode` | [`LanguageMode`](types.md#languagemode) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | The language mode it ran in. |
| `path` | string | no |  | 1 to 32767 characters | 1.0.0 | The script file. |
| `script_block_id` | [`Guid`](types.md#guid) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | The interpreter's script block ID. |
| `text` | string | no |  | 1 to 32767 characters | 1.1.0 | The script text as the interpreter logged it. Collected only when permitted, and redacted by default, like the command line (#228). Since 1.1. |
